lines.zh: 沉重的步声响起，铁链发出叮当声。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps, chains clinking.

lines.zh: 它缓慢前行，金属部件摩擦作响。
lines.en: Moving slowly, metal parts grinding.

lines.zh: 脚下的铁链摩擦地面，发出声响。
lines.en: Chains clink against the ground.

lines.zh: 它踏过熔岩地，金属发出红光。
lines.en: Steps on lava, metal glows red.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声在下界回荡。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the Nether.
Mechanical footsteps approach.

lines.zh: 铁链碰撞的声音清晰可闻。
lines.en: Sounds of clashing chains.
Foot moves, chains shift slightly.

lines.zh: 巨大的合金身躯缓缓前进。
lines.en: Massive alloy body moves slowly.

lines.zh: 沉重的金属脚步声，震得地动。
lines.en: Heavy metal footsteps shake the ground.

lines.zh: 我的关节在高温里咔咔响。
lines.en: My joints click in the heat.
Lava glints off my alloy shell.

lines.zh: 每一步都震落一层余烬。
lines.en: Every step shakes loose a layer of embers.
I walk toward the lava lake.

lines.zh: 它的双眼闪烁着微弱的红光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow faintly red.

lines.zh: 机械的手臂垂下，显得空洞。
lines.en: Its mechanical arms hang, empty.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，机械臂僵硬。
lines.en: It stands still, mechanical arms rigid.
Empty gaze fixed on the distance.
Its arms crossed over its chest.
It stands quietly, waiting.

lines.zh: 机械的关节发出轻微的声响。
lines.en: Mechanical joints make a soft noise.

lines.zh: 它在原地不动，显得非常沉重。
lines.en: It stands still, feeling very heavy.
Its eyes stare ahead.

lines.zh: 机械身躯静止不动，显得冷酷。
lines.en: Mechanical body stands still, cold.

lines.zh: 它的目光转向你，透出寒意。
lines.en: Its gaze shifts to you, chilling.

lines.zh: 它突然看向你，眼中闪烁。
lines.en: It suddenly looks at you, eyes flashing.
It stares at you, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 我胸口那盏南瓜火，转向你。
lines.en: The pumpkin fire in my chest turns to you.
It points at you with a mechanical arm.

lines.zh: 它转向你，眼中满是好奇。
lines.en: It turns to you, eyes curious.

lines.zh: 它的目光坚定地盯住你。
lines.en: Its gaze firmly fixes on you.

lines.zh: 它的眼神锐利地注视着你。
lines.en: Its gaze sharpens on you.

lines.zh: 它突然转向你，眼中充满敌意。
lines.en: It suddenly turns to you, eyes filled with hostility.

lines.zh: 它用机械眼盯着你，毫无感情。
lines.en: Its mechanical eye stares at you, emotionless.
I'm hurt!
My metal skin is damaged.
Metal shards inside me.
My structure is loose.
My metal is rusting.
Mechanical failure.
Loose parts.
Pierced by a sharp object.
Metal is distorted.
A crack has opened in my alloy shell.

lines.zh: 听到金锭声，你被吸引过来。
lines.en: The sound of gold nuggets draws you in.

lines.zh: 看着你的金锭，我对你有兴趣。
lines.en: Your gold nuggets interest me.
Stay. The gold is ours.

lines.zh: 给点金子，我们可以做朋友。
lines.en: Give us some gold, and we'll be friends.
This pumpkin is ours, don't eat it.
Stay back, that pumpkin is dangerous.
I need gold to repair myself.

lines.zh: 喂我金子，你会得到回报。
lines.en: Feed me gold, and you'll get a reward.

lines.zh: 金子，我唯一想要的东西。
lines.en: Gold, the only thing I want.
More gold means more power.
Impact can damage me.
My armor resists impacts.
Be careful, I'm tougher than I look.
Don't use fire on me.

lines.zh: 撞击不能伤害我，但会反弹。
lines.en: Impact bounces off me, but not harming me.
Flame won't work on me.

lines.zh: 撞击不会对我造成伤害。
lines.en: Impact doesn't damage me.
I'll absorb your attacks.
Flame is ineffective against me.

lines.zh: 我的外壳不会被火焰破坏。
lines.en: My shell resists flame.

lines.zh: 四块残骸撑着我，我想找个同类。
lines.en: Four debris blocks hold me up; I want one of my kind.

lines.zh: 废土上还有谁，和我一样结实。
lines.en: Who else on this waste is as solid as me?
I need a companion.

lines.zh: 熔岩边站着的，会是另一个我吗。
lines.en: Could another of me be standing by the lava?

lines.zh: 下界合金的骨架，不需要手软。
lines.en: A netherite frame needs no gentle touch.
Find a suitable female.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣来生育。
lines.en: I need a partner to breed.

lines.zh: 寻找一个伴侣来延续后代。
lines.en: Find a partner to continue our lineage.

lines.zh: 寻找一个雌性来生育后代。
lines.en: Find a female to produce offspring.

lines.zh: 寻找一个雌性来繁衍后代。
lines.en: Find a female for reproduction.

lines.zh: 你拾起了远古残骸碎片。
lines.en: You picked up an Ancient Debris shard.

lines.zh: 这雕刻南瓜散发着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: The carved pumpkin glows ominously.

lines.zh: 远古力量汇聚在你的手中。
lines.en: Ancient power converges in your hand.

lines.zh: 你得到了下界合金碎片。
lines.en: You got a Netherite Fragment.

lines.zh: 这南瓜可以赋予它生命。
lines.en: This pumpkin can bring it to life.

lines.zh: 远古残骸碎片触感冰凉。
lines.en: The Ancient Debris shard feels cold.
Its eyes glow with a dim light.
It uses a pumpkin as its core.

lines.zh: 这远古残骸碎片非同小可。
lines.en: This Ancient Debris shard is no joke.
The pumpkin gave it a soul.

lines.zh: 你发现了附近的下界合金傀儡。
lines.en: You have detected a Netherite Golem nearby.

lines.zh: 它正注视着你的一举一动。
lines.en: It watches your every move.

lines.zh: 下界合金傀儡准备战斗。
lines.en: The Netherite Golem prepares to fight.

lines.zh: 它的目光让你感到寒意。
lines.en: Its gaze sends shivers down your spine.
You have locked onto its position.

lines.zh: 远古残骸铸的身，压得地响。
lines.en: Forged of ancient debris, I make the ground creak.
You have targeted its weak point.

lines.zh: 下界合金傀儡准备发起攻击。
lines.en: The Netherite Golem is ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了怒火。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with rage.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石一响，我听见了。
lines.en: A pebble shifts; I heard it.
Something living has stepped onto the waste.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜核心转了一下。
lines.en: My pumpkin core turns once.

lines.zh: 热量告诉我目标的方向。
lines.en: Heat tells me where the target is.

lines.zh: 这脚步声太轻，不是傀儡。
lines.en: Those steps are too light to be a golem.

lines.zh: 远古残骸拼的身子，吼声很闷。
lines.en: A body of ancient debris gives a muffled roar.

lines.zh: 下界合金傀儡开始移动。
lines.en: The Netherite Golem begins to move.
Its eyes glow.

lines.zh: 下界合金的重，你搬不动。
lines.en: Netherite weight — you cannot move it.
Its weapon spins in its hand.
Its steps are solid and strong.
It seems to be searching for a target.
Its body begins to tremble.
It is ready to attack.
Its eyes are filled with resolve.
My alloy fist tightens. Step into range.
Red light shows through my seams.
I raise my arm, metal grinding.
You have backed up to the lava.
Snarl and swing the hammer!
Swing the huge hammer at the enemy!
Impact the enemy!
Wield the big hammer!
Roar and attack!
Hammer down, enemy falls!
Crash into the enemy!
Split the enemy with the hammer!
Swing the hammer, strike the enemy!
My alloy arm sweeps you off your feet!
One heavy stomp cracks the ground!

lines.zh: 我攥住你的护甲往下压！
lines.en: I grip your armor and press down!

lines.zh: 我撞过去，你撞在岩壁上！
lines.en: I charge, and you hit the basalt wall!
Lava whips off my arm at you!
Rise from the remnants!
Activated by pumpkin pieces!
Created from ancient relics!
Born from ancient dust!
Appears from the alchemy stones!
Summoned by dark energy!

lines.zh: 残骸裂开，我从岩浆气里站起来。
lines.en: The debris splits; I rise out of the lava haze.
Forged in the furnace!
Start with pumpkin pieces!
Summoned from ancient lands!

lines.zh: 四块残骸自行堆叠起来。
lines.en: Four ancient debris blocks stack themselves.

lines.zh: 南瓜落在残骸顶端，我睁眼。
lines.en: The pumpkin lands on top, and I open my eyes.
Lava pours into the seams of the debris.

lines.zh: 我坐着等，直到有人来搭我。
lines.en: I sat waiting until someone built me.
I'm burning!

lines.zh: 这身残骸够重，摔下去地裂了。
lines.en: This debris body is heavy; the ground cracked when I fell.
I drowned.
I was shaken by an explosion.
The arrowhead bends on my alloy.
Magic burn.
Hunger pains.
Lightning strike.
Void darkness.
